g.text: Conditional FGF1–ADCYAP1R1 association: b = +0.127 per mediator SD, p = 0.0177, BH FDR = 0.209 | Dx attenuation = 8.8%
Values remove centered age, sex and SpD effects; middle panel also removes the centered mediator effect.
ΔDx = SCZ − NTC. P-values/FDR are from the original donor-blocked limma fits; boxes supply no new statistical tests.
Each point is a donor–SpD observation; multiple points from one donor are not independent. Shared outcome y-axis.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #455564

g.text: Selection: PACAP receptor signaling offers a neurovascular signaling example. ADCYAP1R1 is not an FGF receptor; this is an outcome association with neuronal FGF1.
